FX-SCATTER-001.says: The settings as they start: Scatter Amount 10, both ways, the same jumble every frame. On a 6 by 4 drawing most pixels read from outside it and are clear.

FX-SCATTER-002.says: Scatter Amount 1, both ways: each pixel from one of its nine neighbours or itself.

FX-SCATTER-004.says: Scatter Amount 2, Grain Horizontal: every pixel stays in its own row.

FX-SCATTER-005.says: Scatter Amount 2, Grain Vertical: every pixel stays in its own column.

FX-SCATTER-006.says: Scatter Amount 0: the picture as it was.

FX-SCATTER-007.says: Scatter Amount 0.4, which rounds to no reach: the picture as it was.

FX-SCATTER-008.says: Scatter Amount 0.5, which rounds to a reach of 1: FX-SCATTER-002.

FX-SCATTER-009.says: Scatter Amount 2, Randomize Every Frame on: a new jumble each frame; frame 0 is FX-SCATTER-003.

FX-SCATTER-010.says: Scatter Amount 2, Randomize Every Frame off: frame 3 is frame 0.

FX-SCATTER-011.says: Scatter Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 1 is 1, frame 2 is 2 and FX-SCATTER-003.

FX-SCATTER-012.says: Scatter Amount keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 127 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 2 would pass 127, is held at 127, and is frame 4.

FX-SCATTER-013.says: FX-SCATTER-003 moved three pixels right: the jumble moves with the drawing.

FX-SCATTER-014.says: After a drop shadow that grows the layer to 10 by 8, Scatter Amount 1: the shadow is jumbled with the drawing.

FX-SCATTER-015.says: Scatter Amount -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATTER-016.says: Scatter Amount 128, above 127. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATTER-017.says: Grain "diagonal", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATTER-018.says: Randomize Every Frame "sometimes", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SCATTER-019.says: Scatter Amount keyed to 200 at frame 4, above 127. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
